content.short: Oku Trade is a no-fee DeFi trading platform powered by Uniswap v3.
content.description: Oku Trade is a no-fee DeFi trading platform powered by Uniswap v3. Traditional DEX interfaces offer only a minimal view of the markets and assets users trade. Oku Trade indexes every Uniswap v3 pool, token, and position to surface past orders, price charts, and other essential details, helping traders make informed decisions before swapping. Traders can place on-chain limit orders and create positions directly on the platform, enabling smoother, more advanced trading workflows.
